name: toybox4
author: ghjob360
tagline: a four-track pocket studio with colour-coded knobs and moving pictures
description: Four tracks, each a string, pulse, FM or cluster synth or a twelve-pad drum kit, with an envelope, an LFO aimed at a knob, an effect, and a four-track event tape that plays at any speed, backwards too, and records over itself. Every screen is a picture that moves with the sound, drawn in the four knobs' colours.
credits: built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hugelton Instruments)
